title: Design System: Sivanesh Job Engine Celebration

display.purpose: Two-line headline inside the celebration only.

motion.name: balloon-loop
motion.purpose: Automatic 5px to -9px bob and -3deg to 3deg rotation.

motion.name: paper-loop
motion.purpose: Static SVG paper drifts -3px to 5px and rotates -1deg to 1deg.

motion.name: confetti-loop
motion.purpose: Continuous recirculating canvas paper with text exclusion; reduced motion clears it. Hidden and offscreen states pause all motion.

review.scope: Fresh motion reviewer approved normal and reduced-motion seven-frame filmstrips, five viewport widths and reduced-motion screenshots. Browser sampling: 15 running loops after 7.5s, zero offscreen, 15 resumed, zero reduced; canvas pixels followed active/still states; no browser errors. Motion-capture CLI failed the pre-interaction rest gate for normal and reduced captures; matched Playwright sampling used unchanged source. Frame-rate smoothness is not established. Deployment verification tracked separately.

components.name: Celebration banner
components.description: Current title-and-employer party poster with actual inline SVG decoration and empty canvas. Font preview requires /assets/fonts/archivo-black.ttf. Static preview; continuous motion runs in celebration.js.
components.html:
You did it,Sivanesh!

Applied Materials

narrative.overview:
A bright yellow party poster celebrates Sivanesh joining Applied Materials. Burgundy lettering, red emphasis, balloon clusters, hanging flags and scattered paper surround a still announcement. Falling confetti and swaying decorations continue automatically while the banner is visible.

This document governs the celebration component only. The archive retains its purple accent, navigation, cards, typography and theme behavior. Source authority is `site/styles.css`, `site/index.html` and `site/celebration.js`; direction context lives in `docs/design/celebration.md`. Fresh motion review approved the continuous-motion revision using normal and reduced-motion seven-frame filmstrips, five viewport widths and reduced-motion screenshots. Deployment verification is tracked separately.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow poster with burgundy lettering and blue, red and pink party decorations.
Centered two-line congratulations in locally hosted Archivo Black, followed only by the employer.
Automatic falling confetti, bobbing balloons and swaying top decorations around a clear text area.
A complete still scene for reduced motion and without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Component Boundary Rule
rules.body: These colors govern the celebration only; the archive keeps its incumbent identity.

dos: Do preserve the archive identity outside the celebration component.
Do keep the title and employer legible without JavaScript.
Do keep balloons, flags and paper visible in reduced motion.
Do pause motion in hidden pages and offscreen banners.
Do keep falling confetti outside the text exclusion rectangle.
donts: Don't apply the banner palette or Archivo Black to archive screens.
Don't add controls or supporting prose to the banner.
Don't make animation necessary to understand the announcement.
Don't treat a static preview as proof of live motion or deployment.
